shots.said: Hey Andy, where are my keys?
shots.heard: hey andy where are my keys
andy said: Hmm, I couldn't find your keys from here. If it has a tracker that beeps, say: listen for my keys. I'll keep looking, and tell you when I see them. Where did you last have them?
fix: Andy didn't point: put the keys where the robot can see it, on the table in front, away from screens (it skips pictures on a TV, and its own TV may be showing the last thing it found).

not rehearsed: "What am I holding?": needs someone holding something up to the robot.
The reminder two minutes later: needs the wait, and a person for Andy to turn to.
